tspan.tspan: OVERVIEW OF COCKPIT CONTROLS AND INSTRUMENTS
FMS FMS OVR Flight Management System: see FMS section in manual.
AP HOVER CTRL AP HOVER Hover Autopilot controls
UTILITY CTRL UTILITY Monitor pacecraft consumables, control mode and lights.
ANNUNC CTRL ANNUNC Display WARNING, CAUTION, and MESSAGE status.
RAD IMU CTRL RAD IMU Radar altitude, velocities, and IMU acceleration.
ATT HDG CTRL ATT HDG Spacecraft attitude and heading indicator.
XPTR CTRL XPTR Graphical autopilot input and output indicator.
